snippet.title: The Escapists 3 - Announcement Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
Find this game and every game from Galaxies Spring on our Steam Event page - https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/45348822/view/719040453611095010

Prison life is calling again. The Escapists 3 is the next chapter in the prison-break series, and it puts you back behind bars with one goal: get out. Learn each prison's daily routine, take on jobs, do favours for your fellow inmates, and quietly gather everything you need without drawing the guards' attention. Craft tools from everyday items, hide your contraband before the next cell search, and find your own way out, whether that's tunnelling, scaling the walls, or something far more creative. Plan your escape alone or recruit friends to help. Every prison is a puzzle, and there's never just one solution.
